definitions.balanced_accuracy: mean of per-class recall over labels present in stratum
definitions.macro_f1: unweighted mean F1 over labels present in stratum
definitions.ci: 95% percentile group bootstrap over source_group_id, resampling groups within stratum
definitions.exploratory: N < 15 or < 8 source groups; no inferential claim
definitions.strata: observational, not randomized; clutter is a scene factor, not degradation
